summary: Three glass stat Cards in a flex row, each with a label, a large value and a delta line.
use: Dashboard KPI strips showing a metric, its value and a short qualifier.
spec: `{#each stats as s}` renders `<Card material="glass" class="stat">` once per stat
Each card has three paragraphs: `{s.label}`, `{s.value}` and `{s.delta}`
